headline: AMD Dips 4% as Investors Lock in Profits After a Blockbuster AI Rotation Surge
summary: AMD (AMD) stock dips 3.29% premarket to $561.80 on broader tech cooling, following a historic second-quarter surge where the chipmaker added $615B in market value.

headline: Super Micro Stock Falls After Taiwan Detains Employees in Nvidia Chip Smuggling Probe
summary: Super Micro Computer shares are trading lower Wednesday after Bloomberg reported that Taiwanese prosecutors detained two Super Micro employees following a raid of the company’s local offices earlier this week tied to an alleged Nvidia Corp chip-smuggling probe.

headline: Dow Hits Record, Meta Soars On AI-Cloud Bet: Stock Market Today
summary: The Dow set a record and software surged, but a 4.5% semiconductor rout sank the Nasdaq 100 as Meta jumped on a plan to sell AI compute.

headline: EXCLUSIVE: Enphase Says Investors Are Valuing It Wrong—and AI Could Change That
summary: Enphase says investors still see a residential solar company, while it is evolving into a power semiconductor platform spanning AI infrastructure, EVs and storage.
